scientific_limits: Full101 converter-level PartVTK/HDF consistency only, not full scientific G1/G2/core.
CSV comparison uses frozen printed-value tolerances; mass_exact is the legacy within-tolerance field label, not bitwise equality.
Type/Mk/Zone source-equivalent saved identity checks do not prove continuous birth/death or material fate.
Pressure is derived EOS/PartVTK pressure, not an independent native pressure measurement.
No new initial-body mass/inertia/pose, ghost/radius or operative-mass proof; preserve800 old primary body mismatches and separate source32 diagnostics.
Initial_type/Mk/mass are not separate fields in the reused comparator; full initial-denominator/source join remains separate.
No threshold/cohort/region/horizon/initial mass rescaling, unconsumed boundary G2, family/core/split promotion or renewed first-sample window.
